module: Management of the marking and detail layers of a Hero Road. A layer (group.layers[i]) describes a decal strip laid on the roadway (material, width, lateral position, texture length, fades, render priority) and becomes one or more DecalRoad objects in the group's scene folder, draped over the road mesh (overObjects). The module also builds the automatic layers (tire tracks, cracks, repairs, damaged asphalt, patches, centerline, edge and lane lines, edge fades) from the actual lane model, and the decals of the placed elements (crosswalk bars, widening dividers, intersection lines); it delegates the repair clusters to repairMgr.
notes: Lateral position of a layer: fraction of the half-width (0 = axis, -1/+1 = left/right edge, >1 = outside the roadway). For N = lanesLeft + lanesRight lanes, lane j is centered at (2j-1-N)/N, the boundary k between lanes at (2k-N)/N, the centerline at (nL-nR)/(nL+nR).
Centerline: no layer if only one direction (lanesLeft or lanesRight = 0). Lane lines: at least 2 lanes, and the boundary between opposite directions (k == lanesLeft) is left to the centerline.

Splitting: a DecalRoad section is limited to 250 m of arc and 500 nodes (16-bit index limit of the GPU buffer, beyond which the end is no longer rendered). Sections join with C1 continuity thanks to handle nodes (startTangent/endTangent). Resampling: 8 m (4 m for edge lines); segments shorter than 0.05 m are welded.
The decal nodes are raised by 2.0 m (decalDrapeHeight) then projected downward onto the mesh collision: the collision must exist before creating the decals.

Only the painted lines (centerline, edge and lane lines) are cut by the potholes marked cutMarkings (0.4 m fade at the cut edge); the edge lines and edge fades are also interrupted at the mouth of an intersection, and follow the widening (edgeBulge).

Default materials: light tracks 'm_tread_marks_clean', heavy 'road_rubber_double', cracks 'm_asphalt_cracks_02', 'repair1', 'repair2', 'road_patches1', 'm_asphalt_damaged_01/02', centerline 'm_line_yellow_double', edge 'm_line_white', lane 'm_line_white_discontinue', fades 'm_road_asphalt_edge', 'm_road_edge_dirt', 'm_road_asphalt_edge_grass'. New manual layer: material 'road_invisible'.

Automatic layers are hidden (isHidden = true) and recreated at each rebuild; removal by pattern (removeXxxLayers) removes any layer whose name contains the type's text (e.g. 'Repair 1'), including a manual layer that happens to have a name containing that text (string.find search with pattern).
canSave of the DecalRoads: false in Edit (nothing is written to the level), true for a Live/baked road (setGroupDecalsCanSave).

getSliderDefaults.desc: Default values of the sliders, for the interface and the reset buttons.

returns.desc: { defaultWidth 10.0, defaultLateralPosition 0.0, defaultRenderPriority 10, defaultTexLength 10.0, defaultFadeIn 1.0, defaultFadeOut 1.0, defaultPaintMargin 0.0, defaultPaintMaterialIdx 0 }.

deepCopyLayer.desc: Deep copy of a layer for undo: temporarily detaches the geometry buffers (pClipped, wClipped, pFlip, wFlip), encodes/decodes, then restores them on the source; the copy receives empty buffers rebuilt at the next update.

deepCopyAllLayers.desc: Deep copy of a list of layers.

updateAllLayers.desc: Updates all the group's layers (creates/updates the DecalRoads of enabled layers, deletes those of disabled layers), then rebuilds the crosswalk bars, widening dividers, intersection lines and repair decals.

groupIdx.desc: Group index (passed to the layer updates).

updateOnlyDirtyLayers.desc: Only updates the layers marked isDirty (creates/updates or deletes their DecalRoad) then resets the flag to false.

removeDecalRoadInLayer.desc: Deletes the layer's DecalRoad object (decalRoadId) and all its split sections (decalRoadIds), if they exist.

setGroupDecalsCanSave.desc: Toggles canSave on all the group's DecalRoads (simple layers and sections, crosswalks, widening dividers, intersection lines) to respect the Edit/Live separation: false = nothing is written to the level, true = written with the road. Called on the Edit/Live switch and after a bake.

persist.desc: true to persist in the level.

removeLayer.desc: Deletes the layer at index idx (its DecalRoad then the list entry).

removeAllLayers.desc: Deletes all the group's layers, as well as the decals of crosswalks, widenings, intersections and repairs.

clearAllLayerDecals.desc: Hides during a drag: deletes all rendered decals (layers, crosswalks, widenings, intersections, repairs) but keeps the layer definitions and the placed elements' data; the rebuild at the end of the drag recreates the decals.

removeAllHiddenLayers.desc: Deletes the hidden (automatic) layers of the group, leaving the manual layers.

addNewLayer.desc: Adds a manual layer 'New Layer N' (material 'road_invisible', width 10 m, position 0, priority 10, texLen 10, track width active).

duplicateLayer.desc: Duplicates the layer at index idx right after it, with a new id and the name '<name> (Copy)'; the source's DecalRoad handles are not copied so that the copy builds its own objects.

idx.desc: Index of the layer to duplicate.

switchOffAllAutoLayers.desc: Disables all automatic layer flags (tracks, damaged asphalt, cracks, repairs, patches, centerline, edge/lane lines, edge fades) and marks the group dirty.

addLightTreadMarksLayers.desc: Adds a hidden 'Light Tread Marks' layer per lane, centered in the lane (material 'm_tread_marks_clean', texLen group.lightTreadTexLen or 5).

removeLightTreadMarksLayers.desc: Deletes the layers whose name contains 'Light Tread Marks'.

addHeavyTreadMarksLayers.desc: Adds a hidden 'Heavy Tread Marks' layer per lane (material 'road_rubber_double', texLen group.heavyTreadTexLen or 5).

removeHeavyTreadMarksLayers.desc: Deletes the layers whose name contains 'Heavy Tread Marks'.

addRoadCrackLayers.desc: Adds a hidden 'Road Crack' layer per lane (material 'm_asphalt_cracks_02', texLen group.roadCrackTexLen or 15).

removeRoadCrackLayers.desc: Deletes the layers whose name contains 'Road Crack'.

addRepair1Layers.desc: Adds a hidden 'Repair 1' layer per lane (material 'repair1', texLen group.repair1TexLen or 25).

removeRepair1Layers.desc: Deletes the layers whose name contains 'Repair 1'.

addRepair2Layers.desc: Adds a hidden 'Repair 2' layer per lane (material 'repair2', texLen group.repair2TexLen or 25).

removeRepair2Layers.desc: Deletes the layers whose name contains 'Repair 2'.

addPatchesLayers.desc: Adds a hidden 'Patches' layer per lane (material 'road_patches1', texLen group.patchesTexLen or 45).

removePatchesLayers.desc: Deletes the layers whose name contains 'Patches'.

addRoadDamageAsphalt1Layers.desc: Adds a hidden 'Damage Asphalt 1' layer per lane (material 'm_asphalt_damaged_01', texLen group.damageAsphalt1TexLen or 10).

removeRoadDamageAsphalt1Layers.desc: Deletes the layers whose name contains 'Damage Asphalt 1'.

addRoadDamageAsphalt2Layers.desc: Adds a hidden 'Damage Asphalt 2' layer per lane (material 'm_asphalt_damaged_02', texLen group.damageAsphalt2TexLen or 25).

removeRoadDamageAsphalt2Layers.desc: Deletes the layers whose name contains 'Damage Asphalt 2'.

addRoadCenterLineLayers.desc: Adds the hidden 'Center Line' layer at the boundary between the left and right lanes (position (nL-nR)/(nL+nR)). Nothing is added for a one-way road. Material group.centerLineMaterial or 'm_line_yellow_double', width of the USA region (or 0.2 m).

removeRoadCenterLineLayers.desc: Deletes the layers whose name contains 'Center Line'.

addRoadEdgeLinesLayers.desc: Adds two hidden layers 'Edge Line - Left' and 'Edge Line - Right' at positions -/+ group.edgeLineOffset (default 1.0 = roadway edge), width group.edgeLineWidth (default 0.25 m), material group.edgeLineMaterial or 'm_line_white'.

removeRoadEdgeLinesLayers.desc: Deletes the layers whose name contains 'Edge Line'.

addRoadLaneLinesLayers.desc: Adds the lane separation lines from the actual lane model: N-1 boundaries at position (2k-N)/N; on a two-way road, the boundary k == lanesLeft is omitted (it is the centerline). Nothing if fewer than 2 lanes. Material group.laneLineMaterial or 'm_line_white_discontinue', width 0.2 m.

removeRoadLaneLinesLayers.desc: Deletes the layers whose name contains 'Lane Line'.

addEdgeBlend1Layers.desc: Adds the 'Edge Blend 1' layers (edge asphalt fade, material 'm_road_asphalt_edge') on each side, with width group.edgeBlend1Width (default 1.0 m) and offset group.edgeBlend1Offset (default 1.1).

addEdgeBlend2Layers.desc: Adds the 'Edge Blend 2' layers (dirt fade, material 'm_road_edge_dirt') on each side, default width 2.0 m, default offset 1.25.

addEdgeBlend3Layers.desc: Adds the 'Edge Blend 3' layers (grass fade, material 'm_road_asphalt_edge_grass') on each side, default width 3.0 m, default offset 1.35.

serializeLayer.desc: Serializes a layer to a simple table (author data: name, id, isHidden, isEnabled, material, isFlip, isTrackWidth, isEdge, edgeSide, edgeOffsetM, isOverObjects, width, position, texLen, fadeIn, fadeOut, renderPriority) without the handles or the runtime geometry.

deserializeLayer.desc: Reconstitutes a layer from a table (missing values replaced by the sliders' defaults), marked isDirty with empty geometry buffers; the objects are created at the next update.

data.desc: Table from serializeLayer or a session file.

returns.desc: Layer ready to be added to group.layers.
